summary: DestProfilePRHistory is a web user control in the HSPnet system that displays and manages instructor PR (Performance Record) history for a given destination. It includes user session controls, data binding, row formatting, and detail toggling for archived/non-archived PRs. The control handles business rules like access restriction and provides UI logic for displaying records and details, with fields and workflows tightly linked to session context.
purpose: To display, manage, and interact with the instructor Performance Record history within the user's permissions and for a specific destination. It supports showing details, formatting, and conditional access based on user session context.

workflows.name: PR History Search, Display, and Detail Toggle
steps: Page loads with session and parameters (UserSession, DestinationCodeID, etc.)
ObjectDataSource dsSrchPRHist selects based on session and destination; access denied if session missing
Repeater rprSrchPRHist binds data for each PR record
Rows are formatted for alternating items (ledger classes), details/archive icons are set based on PR status
Detail icon toggle (cmdDetails) updates visual state for archived/open
Footer row displays if AlternateObservation found
Course leader accesses are restricted; detail controls hidden if CourseLeaderOnly

business_rules: Only users with valid session can access and view PR history
Details control only visible for PR_ID > 0 and users who are not Course Leaders only
Archived PRs show 'detailsarchive icon', active PRs show 'details icon'
Footer visibility based on AlternateObservation flag
validations: Session existence checked before data selection
Detail icon visibility and state based on PR record properties and session context
conditions: Show/hide controls based on PR_ID, CourseLeaderOnly, Archived, ParentPRDID, and AlternateObservation
system_behavior: Cancels data source selection if session is missing
Binds and formats repeater rows with alternating classes
Dynamically updates icons for details based on archival status
Footer row visibility depends on AlternateObservation
exceptions: Data selection is cancelled if session is null
content_gaps: No explicit exception handling or error messages for failed data loads
No information about reporting functionality or PDF output (commented out)
No security details for field visibility beyond CourseLeaderOnly logic
